prompts.face: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production-ready seamless earth cliff wall-face material for a 16-pixel tile RPG. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: an existing Shattered Pixel Dungeon terrain atlas and its meadow grass. Create ONE square opaque tile, filling the whole canvas, viewed straight on as the exposed vertical face of an extremely steep earthen hill that cannot be climbed. Compact brown soil, irregular crumbly earth layers and a few embedded small pebbles, sparse thin exposed roots near the upper edge. A narrow ragged dark green turf lip along the top two logical pixel rows; the remaining fourteen rows are sheer brown dirt, with shallow natural angular fissures. Chunky restrained pixel art exactly on a logical 16 by 16 grid, enlarged as crisp aligned square blocks, 6-8 muted earthy colors, no fine texture, no antialiasing or gradients. Match the game's subdued green and brown materials and small readable shapes. The earth must look natural and almost vertical. Horizontal edges must tile seamlessly with neighboring earth wall faces. No masonry, no brickwork, no timber, no constructed retaining wall, no ladders, no paths, no door, no perspective view, no whole landscape, no people, no labels, no text, no grid lines, no border, no margins, no watermark.
prompts.cap: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production-ready seamless earth cliff top/cap material for a 16-pixel tile RPG. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: an existing Shattered Pixel Dungeon terrain atlas and its meadow grass. Create ONE square opaque material tile filling the entire canvas. Viewed directly from above: compact dark olive-green grassy turf with naturally exposed patches of dark brown soil, root fibers and a few tiny earthen clods. It is the upper surface of a steep earthen bank, with darker crumbling soil along the bottom two logical pixel rows. Chunky restrained pixel art exactly on a logical 16 by 16 grid, enlarged as crisp aligned square blocks, 6-8 muted green and brown colors. Match the existing meadow and subdued game art, use broad pixel clusters and simple shapes. Make the top surface visibly different from wood, stone or bricks. Horizontally seamless. No constructed objects, no trees, no flowers, no whole scenery, no isometric view, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no border, no margins, no watermark, no antialiasing, no smooth gradients.
